summary: Strengthen agricultural cold chain and perishable logistics performance in 5 days. Learn practical tools to cut losses and protect quality.
lede: Agricultural cold chain management covers controlling temperature-sensitive products from collection through storage and delivery. For professionals coordinating these flows, the training supports practical work in qualifying transport routes, monitoring temperatures, and applying HACCP principles to identify and control risks during refrigerated transport.
audienceIntro: This Agricultural Cold Chain and Perishable Logistics Training is tailored for professionals who manage, coordinate, or support temperature-controlled flows of agricultural products from farm to processing, wholesale, and retail markets.
modules: Food Safety, Compliance, and Risk Management
Cost, Energy, and Sustainability in Cold Chains
Performance Management, KPIs, and Vendor Management
Cold Chain Improvement Roadmaps and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: This is an intermediate-level program designed for professionals already working in agriculture, food logistics, or supply chain operations. You should have a working understanding of basic supply chain concepts (planning, warehousing, transport) and familiarity with agricultural products or food handling environments. Prior exposure to food safety (for example HACCP or ISO 22000) is helpful but not mandatory. No coding or programming is required. Data and digital topics such as IoT monitoring, dashboards, and route optimization are taught at operational application level so you can specify requirements, interpret outputs, and manage implementation with technical support.
